directive.gatingQuestion: After repeated resolver closure attempts, does fresh primary-source verification reveal any new factual contradiction between IBM's weak Q2 headline growth and raised full-year expectations/AI positioning?
directive.whyItMatters: IBM remains rank 3 in the resolver queue with unchanged contradiction strings despite prior evidence explicitly stopping the loop; exception research must not repeat indefinitely without new information.
directive.successCondition: Identify materially new conflicting evidence or preserve exact unavailable repeated-route evidence and stop looping.

finding: No materially new contradiction is available. IBM's primary Q2 release still reports $17.2B revenue (+1% YoY), with Software +5%, Data +19%, Red Hat +11%, Distributed Infrastructure +37%, Transaction Processing -8%, Infrastructure -7%, and raised full-year constant-currency revenue growth expectations of 4%-5% while acknowledging late-Q2 revenue headwinds. Mixed segment performance and forward execution risk are compatible with weak quarterly headline growth. Prior resolver evidence already closed this route and explicitly recommended no further resolver loop.

evidenceVsInference.evidence: IBM Q2 revenue grew 1%; Software grew 5%, Data 19%, Red Hat 11%, Distributed Infrastructure 37%, while Transaction Processing fell 8% and Infrastructure fell 7%. IBM raised FY constant-currency revenue growth expectation to 4%-5% and acknowledged late-quarter revenue headwinds.
evidenceVsInference.inference: Raised expectations and strategic AI positioning can coexist with weak quarterly headline growth when segment mix is divergent. Guidance delivery remains execution risk rather than a present factual contradiction.

recommendedDisposition: Do not route IBM back to deep-resolver for these unchanged contradiction strings. Consume the existing resolved disposition during reconcile or preserve conservative treatment outside the resolver lane.
